1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000020_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
1.description: Unafraid and unconcerned in spite of their weakness, and how easily their lives could be torn apart in an instant...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000030_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
2.description: Such luxuries are lost to us. We have no hopes or dreams─not even the release of death. Only hunger.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000040_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
3.description: Others are a means to an end. At times a literal one.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000050_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
4.description: We forge covenants with men, and come here to feed. Or to die.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000060_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
5.description: I thought it would be no different when I was summoned by Zenos.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
6.description: Lives were tools to him, to be used and discarded at whim. In that respect, he was a voidsent at heart.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
7.description: But towards you and you alone, he behaved...differently. And I cannot fathom why.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000090_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
8.description: What was it that drove him? What made him choose such an end?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000100_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
9.description: But enough about that man. He is dead, and we are all better for it.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000110_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
10.description: Why are you here? Was there something you needed?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000120_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
11.description: So you're heading back now. Then as per our bargain, I will go as well.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000130_VARSHAHNBIG
12.description: Everyone is here? Good. Let us set forth for the void once more.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000160_VARSHAHNBIG
15.description: What is the meaning of this...?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000170_YSHTOLA
16.description: Unless I'm mistaken, that was intended for one of your kin. Who?

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000180_VARSHAHNBIG
17.description: It was for the briefest of moments, but...I felt her. Azdaja.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000190_ESTINIEN
18.description: I thought she was in the void.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000200_VARSHAHNBIG
19.description: As did I. Yet the presence was unmistakable.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000210_VARSHAHNBIG
20.description: Thus did I call out...only for it to fade and vanish.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000220_YSHTOLA
21.description: Perhaps...she crossed over to the Source then immediately turned back?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000240_VARSHAHNBIG
23.description: Could she have found a way home...?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000250_YSHTOLA
24.description: The how of it aside, if she was indeed in the Source, there may be clues where she came through that could lead us back to her.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000260_YSHTOLA
25.description: Where exactly was it that you felt her presence?

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000270_VARSHAHNBIG
26.description: Far to the north. That was all I could discern.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000280_ESTINIEN
27.description: The north, you say? Beyond the Bounty─Garlemald?

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000290_YSHTOLA
28.description: As good a place to start as any.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000300_YSHTOLA
29.description: My apologies, Zero, but your return to the void will have to wait.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000310_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
30.description: I told you before that I have no reason to go back there. Do as you will.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000320_YSHTOLA
31.description: ...All right. I presume you wish to stay here in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han until we return?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000330_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
32.description: You've kept me amply fed. I wouldn't be averse to helping you on your search.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000340_YSHTOLA
33.description: If Azdaja was indeed here, other voidsent may have made the journey as well...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000350_YSHTOLA
34.description: Very well, we would welcome your company.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000360_ESTINIEN
35.description: If it's decided, then I'll contact our associates in Garlemald.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000370_ESTINIEN
36.description: ...It's me. Still talking everyone's ears off, I trust?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000400_ESTINIEN
39.description: We'll need to teleport to make it there in time. Can you?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000410_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
40.description: Aye. I know it well from my time as an avatar.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000420_ESTINIEN
41.description: Then it seems we're all set.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000430_YSHTOLA
42.description: If there is nothing else, let us see to our final preparations.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000450_ALPHINAUD
44.description: My friends, 'tis good to see you again.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000460_YSHTOLA
45.description: And you. I was worried that the cold wouldn't agree with you, but you're both looking quite well.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000470_ALISAIE
46.description: You get used to it. It helps that there's no shortage of fuel and heaters like before.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000480_YSHTOLA
47.description: Glad to hear it. Have you been working in Garlemald all this time?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000490_ALPHINAUD
48.description: We have. Though the worst is behind them, the people still have a long road ahead.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000500_ALPHINAUD
49.description: They've taken steps towards forming an interim government, but it will be some time before any large-scale reconstruction effort can be carried out in earnest.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000510_ALPHINAUD
50.description: With the nation in ruins and the leadership void yet to be filled, there remains a lack of direction─a pervasive sense of aimlessness and worry.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000520_ALISAIE
51.description: So we'll keep doing what we can until they can finally stand on their own.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000530_ALISAIE
52.description: Still, everyone wants to make things better, and we're here to help.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000540_ALISAIE
53.description: A lot of Garleans wanted nothing to do with us, but they're starting to come around. Slowly but surely.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
56.description: It sounds like quite the undertaking.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000550_ALPHINAUD
57.description: You're too kind. But it's thanks to the cooperation of like-minded souls that we've been able to make any progress.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000560_ALPHINAUD
58.description: Indeed, it has not been easy. But we've been able to make progress thanks to the cooperation of like-minded souls.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000570_ALPHINAUD
59.description: The allied nations continue to send supplies which allow us to meet basic needs such as food and shelter.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000580_ALPHINAUD
60.description: Meanwhile, Jullus and a number of soldiers have begun a restoration initiative, with more and more volunteers joining by the day.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000590_ALISAIE
61.description: Like Alphinaud said, they've got a long road ahead of them. But we'll get there together─one step at a time.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000600_ALPHINAUD
62.description: Though you yourself helped them take one especially big step, didn't you? In vanquishing that blasphemy in the Tower of Babil.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000610_ALPHINAUD
63.description: Thank you. I can only hope that your deed will help the people to find peace and closure.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000620_ALISAIE
64.description: But enough about events here. What brings you to us? And with new company besides.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000630_YSHTOLA
65.description: This may take rather a long time to explain, but bear with me...

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000640_ALISAIE
66.description: The Thirteenth!? After traveling to the edge of existence, I thought you'd keep your escapades closer to home for a while...

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000650_ALISAIE
67.description: But I suppose there's no stopping you. Not that I'm one to talk, of course...

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000660_ALPHINAUD
68.description: The heart of an adventurer cannot be denied.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000670_ALPHINAUD
69.description: The heart of an adventurer cannot be denied.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000680_ALISAIE
70.description: You could have at least invited me too! Surely there was room enough for me and G'raha in the undersea vault?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000690_ALISAIE
74.description: Oh, it's fine. You can make it up to me on the next one.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000700_ALISAIE
75.description: I know, I know. I only meant to tease. Mostly...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000710_ALISAIE
76.description: But on a more serious note... Are we sure it's wise to keep Zenos's former avatar around?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000720_ALISAIE
77.description: I understand how you came to work together, but nevertheless...

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000730_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
78.description: You're right to be cautious. I'm a voidsent after all. But do not conflate me with Zenos.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
79.description: To recall my time in his service─it...angers me...

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000760_ALISAIE
81.description: I think we'll get along just fine, you and I.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000770_VARSHAHNBIG
82.description: Now that we are all caught up, to the matter at hand.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000780_VARSHAHNBIG
83.description: As we were about to resume our search in the void, I felt the presence of my sister Azdaja in the Source. Somewhere in the far north─perhaps even here in Garlemald.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000790_VARSHAHNBIG
84.description: If you have seen or heard anything out of the ordinary, I must know.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000800_ALPHINAUD
85.description: As a matter of fact, we may have.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000810_ALPHINAUD
86.description: In recent days, we have had to contend with a surprising number of voidsent. And not the lesser kind that occasionally manifest, but ones possessed of considerable power.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000820_YSHTOLA
87.description: You think they might have been summoned? By whom?

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000830_ALPHINAUD
88.description: We're not sure. But as Jullus reminded us, practitioners of a certain traditional Garlean art rely upon voidsent servants.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000840_ALPHINAUD
89.description: The very same I believe you have mastered.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000850_ALPHINAUD
90.description: While there are no known reapers left in Garlemald, we can't rule out the possibility that some are working in secret.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000860_ESTINIEN
91.description: To summon not one, but several powerful voidsent, is no small feat. But if Azdaja was indeed called from the void...

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000870_YSHTOLA
92.description: Then it is likely the same party is responsible.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000880_YSHTOLA
93.description: Alternatively, the aetheric confluence at the Tower of Babil may have triggered an expansion of natural fissures one could use to cross over, but I think that improbable if not impossible.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000890_VARSHAHNBIG
94.description: Then we must assume these events have indeed been orchestrated.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000900_ALISAIE
95.description: Well, summoned or no, we've been trying to track them to their origin. It's the mountains to the east, we think.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000920_ALPHINAUD
97.description: I would, but the terrain is too difficult to traverse on foot. Nor is flying an option due to the winds.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000930_ESTINIEN
98.description: Too much ground to cover in any case. Is there no way to narrow it down?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000940_ALPHINAUD
99.description: There is one place we thought to look first: an isolated village rumored to have once been home to a reaper order.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000950_YSHTOLA
100.description: That would indeed make an excellent start. Though the question of how to get there remains.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000960_ALPHINAUD
101.description: Jullus may be of assistance. Let us return to Camp Broken Glass and consult him.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000970_ALISAIE
102.description: What was it you wished to talk about?

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000980_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
103.description: Why do you help these people?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_000990_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
104.description: What is it that you stand to gain?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001010_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
106.description: You don't act on behalf of a higher power, nor are you bound by a contract. In spite of this, you help them. Why?

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001020_ALISAIE
107.description: And there I thought it was something serious...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001030_ALISAIE
108.description: I help them because I want to. Because it's the right thing to do.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001040_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
109.description: ...But what do you stand to gain? You didn't answer the question.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001050_ALISAIE
110.description: Didn't I? I followed my heart. What I got out of it came after.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001060_ALISAIE
111.description: Was there anything else? If not, let's keep moving.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
113.description: To act not out of obligation or in pursuit of gain. To simply...live. And they survive like this...?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001100_ALISAIE
115.description: The cold doesn't let up out here, does it...

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001110_ALISAIE
116.description: They've the means to keep everyone warm at Camp Broken Glass and Tertium. But the measures are still only temporary.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001120_ALISAIE
117.description: Subsisting on charity, dreading the day the sympathy of others is exhausted─it's no way to live. They need lasting safety and security.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001130_ALISAIE
118.description: Though things will never be as they once were...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001140_ALISAIE
119.description: If we can restore a modicum of normalcy to their lives, maybe that will be enough for them to move forward.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001150_ALISAIE
120.description: If we're to achieve that, we have to work harder. I have to work harder.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
122.description: You're doing your best. Anyone can see that.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
123.description: Just try not to overdo it, eh?

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001170_ALISAIE
125.description: L-Lest you misunderstand, I wasn't fishing for a compliment... As I said, I'm doing this because I want to.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001190_ALISAIE
127.description: Oh, come now, you think I don't know my own limits?

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001210_ALISAIE
129.description: Well, our work here is done. We should be heading back.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001220_ALISAIE
130.description: I hope Alphinaud and Zero haven't gotten into any trouble.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001230_ALISAIE
131.description: I cannot imagine how awful it must have been to serve as Zenos's avatar. To not only suffer him, but so much else...

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001240_ALISAIE
132.description: She's a fighter all right. Like you and me.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001280_RESTLESSGARLEAN10320
136.description: Excuse me, Alphinaud. My wife, she's come down with a high fever. Do you think you could take a look at her?

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001290_ALPHINAUD
137.description: Of course. Give me a moment.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001300_ALPHINAUD
138.description: Zero, may I leave the rest here to you?

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001320_JULLUS
140.description: Thank you again for your help.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001330_JULLUS
141.description: Er...Zero, was it? I take it you're one of Alphinaud's comrades?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001340_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
142.description: Comrade...? We've entered into a cooperative pact, if that's what you mean.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001350_JULLUS
143.description: Pact? No, no, nothing so formal. What I mean is, you must know each other well. Be on good terms, enjoy each other's company─that sort of thing.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001360_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
144.description: Then no, he's not my comrade. I have none. Nor will I ever, I think.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001390_JULLUS
147.description: No, not at all. On the contrary, it makes sense.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001400_JULLUS
148.description: When Alphinaud and the contingent first arrived, we rejected them out of hand.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001410_JULLUS
149.description: Whatever they may have claimed, they were the enemy. Savages with their savage ways. To accept their help was to admit defeat.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001420_JULLUS
150.description: But no matter how poorly we treated them, they didn't turn their backs on us. They stayed and listened.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001430_JULLUS
151.description: That's just the kind of people they are. Makes sense they'd get along with someone like you, who tries to push others away.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001440_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
152.description: Get along? I'm upholding my part of the bargain. There's nothing more to it than that.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001460_JULLUS
154.description: Ah, I'd nearly forgotten why I came. Are you hungry?

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001470_JULLUS
155.description: We all get rations, and considering the work you're doing, you're as good as one of us.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001480_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
156.description: I am running low on aether... Very well.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001490_JULLUS
157.description: Azim Steppe-style dumplings. Buuz, they call them.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001500_JULLUS
158.description: Never had a dumpling? It's like...a kind of bread stuffed with a filling─meat or vegetables usually─that you bake or steam.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001510_JULLUS
159.description: We have our own recipes in Garlemald, too. My mother liked to make them. My brother and sister always fought over the jam-filled ones...

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001520_JULLUS
160.description: J-Just think of it as bread, all right?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001530_JULLUS
161.description: I should warn you, though, they're spicy─helps them keep longer, I assume. Too much for the children to handle, though.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001560_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
164.description: I don't know much about taste. Not anymore. But I do feel a sensation in my mouth.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001590_JULLUS
167.description: Heh, that's enough for me. I've heard it said that spices are more akin to fire than flavors. Perhaps that makes them easier to understand.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001600_ALISAIE
168.description: Oh, Jullus. Getting acquainted with Zero, are we?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001620_ALISAIE
170.description: No harm in that. Acquaint away!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001630_ALPHINAUD
171.description: Ah, everyone is here. Excellent. Thank you all for your hard work.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001640_ALPHINAUD
172.description: I've just finished up myself. Shall we go and find Estinien?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001680_JULLUS
176.description: Voidsent─I'd bet my life on it. Understood. I'll investigate at once.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001690_JULLUS
177.description: A unit transporting supplies has gone silent en route to Broken Glass. I will go and search for it. Stay here and keep watch, but be ready to answer my call.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001700_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
178.description: If it was voidsent, you'd be a fool to go alone.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001710_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
179.description: They'll find you before you find your men. And then they'll devour you as well.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001730_JULLUS
181.description: Perhaps you're right. Perhaps I don't stand a chance. But I can't just abandon them!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
182.description: I can't repay you for the bread if you're dead. I'll go.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001750_JULLUS
183.description: What!? No! I couldn't possibly ask you to do that!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001760_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
184.description: I'm far better suited to dealing with voidsent. It makes sense.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001770_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
185.description: Or do you mean to say you'd rather I stay here because you can't protect this place on your own?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001790_JULLUS
188.description: Fine. Just...don't do anything stupid. Promise me!

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001840_VOIDSENT10410
193.description: Ah, of course. You sold your soul to feed.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001850_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
195.description: I have taken bread. But my soul is forever mine.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001870_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
197.description: How big must the gate be for their like to come through...

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001900_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
200.description: When Light still shone upon the world... When the Contramemoria still raged...

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001910_MEMORIAMASTERA10430
201.description: Stand aside if you value your life.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001920_MEMORIAMASTERB10430
202.description: We're only after women and wine. Darkness can take the rest.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001930_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
203.description: You're not taking another step towards that village.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001958_MEMORIAMASTERB10430
210.description: And now we can get back to our business.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_001970_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
212.description: Get up... Get up, damn you!

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
215.description: The same mistakes, the same ends. Again and again. What should I...what could I have done?

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002030_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
218.description: You... What are you doing here...?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002040_ALISAIE
219.description: Y'shtola and Estinien had matters well in hand. So we went where we were needed.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
222.description: You're not finished yet, Zero. Let's fight together.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
223.description: We're a little late, but we've come to help you.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
225.description: I will let it burn, this fire in my breast. Let it burn and rage and guide.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
226.description: You did well to find me out here.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002090_ALPHINAUD
227.description: We have Jullus to thank for that. He was quite worried when he called.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
229.description: There would've been more casualties if not for you.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
230.description: The people of Garlemald thank you.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002100_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
231.description: No, if it was not for you and the others, I...

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002110_ALISAIE
232.description: Well, let's not fuss over details. We should return to Tertium─can you make it that far?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
235.description: Well enough. No voidsent struck here, did they?

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002150_JULLUS
236.description: No, and there weren't any more casualties thanks to you.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002180_JULLUS
239.description: You'll have no debts to repay, if that's what you're worried about.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002190_JULLUS
240.description: If anything, I owe you a week's worth of buuz.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002210_WATERMONOLITH
242.description: Hah hah hah! All shall cower before the might of Archfiend Cagnazzo!

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002230_VARSHAHNBIG
244.description: A dragon of our world crossed over into yours long ago, but I have felt her presence here again. What is the meaning of this?

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002240_WATERMONOLITH
245.description: I daresay what you felt...was this.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002260_VARSHAHNBIG
247.description: You... What have you done to Azdaja!?

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002270_WATERMONOLITH
248.description: If you want answers, you'll have to get them from Lord Golbez.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002280_WATERMONOLITH
249.description: Assuming you've the strength to face him.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002290_WATERMONOLITH
250.description: A pity I will not see the plan to fruition, but my part is done. And to fade with the thrill of battle in my heart makes it all the more worthwhile...

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002300_VARSHAHNBIG
251.description: No, wait! Where is she!? Where is my sister!?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002310_WATERMONOLITH
252.description: At long last, I go to join the great flow...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002320_YSHTOLA
253.description: By the gate's closing, there can be no doubt that he was the one who opened it.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002330_VARSHAHNBIG
254.description: Oh, Azdaja... I prayed we might meet once more...

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002340_ESTINIEN
255.description: She is likely still in the void. Take heart─we will find her yet.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002360_ALPHINAUD
257.description: While you discuss how to proceed with your search, I would excuse myself to look around. There may be salvage that we could use at the camp.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002370_ALISAIE
258.description: In that case, I'll patrol the area for more voidsent.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002380_YSHTOLA
259.description: Very well, let us take a moment to consider our options.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002420_VARSHAHNBIG
263.description: I am. As distressing as this turn of events was, the eye itself gives me cause to hope.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002430_VARSHAHNBIG
264.description: While it is no longer possessed of Azdaja's will, it may yet lead us to her.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002440_VARSHAHNBIG
265.description: Were it not for your encouragement, I would never have dared to embark on my search, much less come this far.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002450_VARSHAHNBIG
266.description: I will not lose faith. I will find my sister, wheresoever she may be.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002460_ESTINIEN
267.description: We'll return the eye to her together.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002470_YSHTOLA
268.description: Though tainted, the eye has not fully succumbed to Darkness. Azdaja herself may have been able to resist its influence.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002480_ALISAIE
269.description: Well, as much as we'd love to take part in your next foray, we can't abandon our efforts here.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002490_ALPHINAUD
270.description: Indeed. We'll need to keep a close watch in case the voidgate opens again as well.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002500_ALPHINAUD
271.description: Though should it prove safe to do so, I have some ideas for how we might put this village to use.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002510_ESTINIEN
272.description: Do what you must. We will manage.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002520_YSHTOLA
273.description: To free Azdaja, I expect we will have to deal with Golbez once and for all─after which you may undertake your work without worry.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002530_ALPHINAUD
274.description: We look forward to the glad tidings.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002540_ALISAIE
275.description: You'll take good care of everyone, won't you?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002550_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
276.description: What? Why do you ask me this?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002560_ALISAIE
277.description: Because comrades look out for one another, and I can't think of anyone more qualified to keep them safe.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002570_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
278.description: True. I will do no less than I've promised.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002580_ALPHINAUD
279.description: If our respective plans are settled, then let us head back.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002590_VARSHAHNBIG
280.description: If everyone is ready, then let us depart for Alzadaal's Legacy.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002610_YSHTOLA
282.description: A deluge of aether. The mark of a terrible magick.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002620_ESTINIEN
283.description: It wasn't far from here. Let's go!

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002630_PANICFISHERMAN10720
284.description: Hey, you! Stop! If you're thinking of taking to sea─don't!

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002650_PANICFISHERMAN10720
286.description: We were out working our nets when a light suddenly shot up over Bhaflau Isle with a boom!

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002660_PANICFISHERMAN10720
287.description: A massive fiend then took to the skies.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002670_PANICFISHERMAN10720
288.description: Another blasphemy, we feared─but we didn't linger to find out.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002680_VARSHAHNBIG
289.description: Did you see where it was headed?

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002690_PANICFISHERMAN10720
290.description: Can't say for sure, but it looked like it was northward bound.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002700_VARSHAHNBIG
291.description: I see... Our thanks for the warning, and do not let us keep you.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002710_VARSHAHNBIG
292.description: Bhaflau Isle is connected to Alzadaal's Legacy. This cannot be a coincidence.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002720_YSHTOLA
293.description: In response to Cagnazzo's defeat, they have come for our gate...

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002730_VARSHAHNBIG
294.description: So it seems. I would ascertain the situation at the vault, but the fiend must be dealt with ere people come to harm.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002740_VARSHAHNBIG
295.description: I shall assume my dragon form and seek it out at once.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002760_ESTINIEN
297.description: You heard the fisherman. A blasphemy, they called it.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002770_ESTINIEN
298.description: If another flying creature were sighted now, others will assume the worst, and panic will spread. This is not the way.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
301.description: We can work together on this.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002790_VARSHAHNBIG
303.description: I will gather my soldiers and search the isle for casualties.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002800_VARSHAHNBIG
304.description: As you wish, the fiend is yours.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002810_VARSHAHNBIG
305.description: The fiend, I leave to you.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002820_VARSHAHNBIG
306.description: The hunt will go more swiftly with help. Zero, might I prevail upon you to accompany <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>?

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002840_YSHTOLA
308.description: Then Estinien and I will make for Alzadaal's Legacy and secure the gate.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002850_VARSHAHNBIG
309.description: Stay on your guard. The enemy is clever and will have anticipated our response.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002860_VARSHAHNBIG
310.description: Be safe, my friends, and may the Sisters guide your steps.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002880_YSHTOLA
312.description: (-Y'shtola-)We were too late. The vault has been destroyed, the alchemical furnace with it.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002890_YSHTOLA
313.description: (-Y'shtola-)This was their true objective─to deny us entry into the void.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002900_YSHTOLA
314.description: (-Y'shtola-)Cagnazzo and Azdaja's eye were a diversion.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002910_YSHTOLA
315.description: (-Y'shtola-)A means to detain us in Garlemald while they went to work here.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002920_YSHTOLA
316.description: (-Y'shtola-)To reduce the vault to rubble... That which you hunt is no ordinary foe. Have care.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002930_FIREMONOLITH
317.description: (-???-)Such an exquisite sight... A canvas of vibrant colors. As was our world too, once...

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
319.description: One of Golbez's champions, I presume.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
320.description: Are you the one who destroyed the treasure vault?

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002940_FIREMONOLITH
321.description: I am. Rubicante, the archfiend of fire.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002950_FIREMONOLITH
322.description: A monster in flesh, yet in spirit I remain a man. A prisoner of the past.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002960_FIREMONOLITH
323.description: Such tears I wept when Darkness consumed the world. Until Lord Golbez came and spoke of salvation.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002970_FIREMONOLITH
324.description: Thus do I walk proudly at his side, to see his dream fulfilled.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002980_FIREMONOLITH
325.description: Your heart is pure. For benevolent cause you seek the dragon.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_002990_FIREMONOLITH
326.description: But I cannot allow you to have it─cannot allow you to interfere. If you would continue, then there is but one recourse.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003000_FIREMONOLITH
327.description: I shall await you at the summit. Come, mortal! Come and weigh your righteousness against mine!

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003010_FIREMONOLITH
328.description: You stayed the course─as I knew you would. As too will I. Come!

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003020_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
329.description: It seems I was a step too slow.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003040_FIREMONOLITH
331.description: To defeat all of us archfiends... You are strong indeed.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
333.description: What is it that Golbez seeks?

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
334.description: Why do you fight? What is it that you wish to save?

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003050_FIREMONOLITH
335.description: You would know my lord's true purpose?

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003060_FIREMONOLITH
336.description: Very well. The knowledge will not change the outcome. Listen, then, and learn how all began...

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003070_FIREMONOLITH
337.description: You would know your enemy's heart?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003080_FIREMONOLITH
338.description: Very well. It bleeds more than you can ever understand, but I will speak, and you will listen, and learn how all began...

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003090_BLACKKNIGHT
339.description: How long has it been since the world was undone...

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003100_BLACKKNIGHT
340.description: Since Light and life gave way to Darkness and undeath. Since we were reduced to beasts befouled, squabbling over what scant aether remains...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003110_BLACKKNIGHT
341.description: But you are different. You remember who you were, and the paradise for which you fought.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003120_BLACKKNIGHT
342.description: That world will never be ours again. But we need not suffer in this purgatory of death and rebirth forever.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003130_BLACKKNIGHT
343.description: Join me, and together we shall seek the promised land!

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003140_FIREMONOLITH
344.description: There is no hope─no freedom from the wheel. You speak a fantasy.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003150_BLACKKNIGHT
345.description: I speak truth. The Ascians' revelation. There are other worlds than this. Ours is but one of fourteen.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003160_BLACKKNIGHT
346.description: There is no greater proof than the whispers we hear─born of a neighboring reality.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003170_BLACKKNIGHT
347.description: A reality to which we may journey if we can but break down the barrier that divides us.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003180_WATERMONOLITH
348.description: You meant it, then? We will take this world as our own?

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003200_BLACKKNIGHT
350.description: In return for your strength, I offer you opportunity to pursue your own ends in service to a greater cause...

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003210_BLACKKNIGHT
351.description: A glorious kingdom of Light, wherein all may know death's sweet embrace!

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003220_FIREMONOLITH
352.description: ...And thus did we begin our great work.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003230_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
353.description: You intend to forsake the Thirteenth and conquer the Source?

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003240_FIREMONOLITH
354.description: Just so. Our home is a lost cause, our only choice to begin anew.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003250_FIREMONOLITH
355.description: In this world, where we may reclaim our mortality.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003260_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
356.description: You served Golbez of your own volition...

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003270_FIREMONOLITH
357.description: As atonement for my failures. I tried to be a hero. Tried to stop the war...but I could not.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003280_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
358.description: So in turn you wage another?

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003290_FIREMONOLITH
359.description: A means to a final end. The wheel of depravity must be broken.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003300_FIREMONOLITH
360.description: Even the most exalted succumb. We eat and eat and deepen the stain upon our souls, until only the hunger remains. Is this to be our fate for all eternity?

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003310_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
361.description: ...I don't know. About this and a great many things.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003320_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
362.description: But I do know that it's wrong to damn another to save yourself.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003330_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
363.description: Not everything need be a trade. This I learned from the people of this world.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003340_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
364.description: Even without a contract, without any expectation of personal gain, they labor for one another.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003350_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
365.description: I didn't understand it at first─and perhaps I still don't. But if I'm to achieve something, I'd rather do it their way. Else I am already a hunger-maddened beast.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003370_FIREMONOLITH
367.description: Perhaps we have indeed surrendered to the hunger after a fashion.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003380_FIREMONOLITH
368.description: Make for our moon. There you will find both Lord Golbez and your dragon.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A9_000_001_NONE_VOICE
370.description: Why are you telling us this?

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003390_FIREMONOLITH
372.description: To be so viciously slandered... Pride demands I prove my virtue at the last.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003400_FIREMONOLITH
373.description: Never. Our triumph is at hand, and the knowledge will avail you naught.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003410_FIREMONOLITH
374.description: But to be so viciously slandered... Pride demands I prove my virtue at the last.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003420_FIREMONOLITH
375.description: And perhaps your own will resonate with his...and draw forth that singular jewel which abides deep within his heart.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003430_FIREMONOLITH
376.description: A desire which lies beyond his quest to free us from our purgatory. A desire...all his own...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003440_YSHTOLA
377.description: Thank goodness you're both all right.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003450_YSHTOLA
378.description: Unfortunately, we have nothing further to report apart from the loss of the gate.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003460_YSHTOLA
379.description: But tell us─how did you fare on the mountain?

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003470_YSHTOLA
380.description: Golbez aspires to deliver voidsent unto the Source...

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003480_YSHTOLA
381.description: Where they may die and return to the Lifestream to be reborn.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003490_ESTINIEN
382.description: Far be it from me to deny them, but the cost to our people would be beyond unconscionable.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003500_YSHTOLA
383.description: Indeed. Voidsent themselves are inherently dangerous, never mind the chaos sure to follow should the barrier 'twixt our worlds be shattered. 'Twould be naught less than a calamity.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003510_YSHTOLA
387.description: Certainly not. That said, our task has been rendered rather difficult.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003520_YSHTOLA
388.description: The simplest way would, of course, be to strike at Golbez himself. That said, our task has been rendered rather difficult.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003530_VRITRA
389.description: Indeed... Rubicante hath deprived us of a means to cross into the void.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003540_YSHTOLA
390.description: Cagnazzo's feint. That was doubtless what he meant when he said his part was done.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003550_ESTINIEN
391.description: Golbez sacrificed two archfiends just to stop us. He must need more time to break the barrier to our world.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003560_VRITRA
392.description: Then the days ahead will be critical. We must find a way back to the Thirteenth.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003570_YSHTOLA
393.description: We could employ another Atomos, but that approach would only be viable if we found another planar fissure. An unlikely prospect.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003590_YSHTOLA
395.description: If you will excuse my absence, I shall return to Sharlayan to look for information.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003600_VRITRA
396.description: By all means. Meanwhile, I shall seek the counsel of our alchemists.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003610_YSHTOLA
397.description: Time is of the essence, so─wish me luck.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003620_ESTINIEN
398.description: I'm no scholar. I'll find another way to keep myself busy here.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A11_000_001_NONE_VOICE
400.description: Y'shtola alone will be more a match for those tomes.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_A11_000_002_NONE_VOICE
401.description: How about a little training to keep your lance arm honed?

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003630_ESTINIEN
403.description: I don't doubt it. She's a veritable “Researcher of Light.”

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003640_ESTINIEN
404.description: Heh, rest assured I never shirk my training. I will be ready for whatever awaits.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003650_VRITRA
405.description: Zero. May we call upon thee when next we venture unto the Thirteenth?

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003660_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
406.description: Aye. And in case you're wondering, I won't ask for further payment.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003670_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
407.description: I will go for myself. To try and understand why I spoke the words I said to Rubicante...

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003680_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
408.description: And the fire I felt within when you all came to my aid in Garlemald.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003690_ESTINIEN
409.description: While our esteemed sorceress battles her tomes, let us see to our own affairs.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003700_VRITRA
410.description: I will not fail you again, Sister...

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003710_BLACKKNIGHT
411.description: Cagnazzo and Rubicante have joined with the great flow...

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003720_BLACKKNIGHT
412.description: In this world, 'tis the ravenous who are useful. And few were as ravenous as they.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003730_BLACKKNIGHT
413.description: You were fine pawns, my archfiends, and you have played your parts to perfection.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003740_BLACKKNIGHT
414.description: But with the goal in sight, I need no minions to do my bidding.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003760_BLACKKNIGHT
416.description: At long, long last...the end draws nigh.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06300_003770_BLACKKNIGHT
417.description: The end to life on that star. And the end to my suffering...
